div.div: Pair labels: distinct module-to-module import pairs per direction (left to right / right to left), non-test sources, origin/main. Also: Collaboration to Corpus 5 pairs, Submission to Corpus 3 pairs. Cycles exist (AI and corpus import each other; platform modules import back into upper packages). Green = API modules, orange = workers, grey = shared core.
